Vero (customer): Hi, I signed up a few hours ago and completed email verification but my free trial credits never showed up. account id: acct_01Gxyz. Can someone check?
Sam (support): Sorry about that — can you confirm the country on the payment method and the region you selected during signup?
Vero (customer): Payment card is issued in Spain, billing address Spain. Region selected: europe-west. Email verified at 1778356000.
Sam (support): Thanks — checking initial flags. @Billing Bot can you run a quick account audit for acct_01Gxyz?
Billing Bot: Audit result for acct_01Gxyz: free_trial_granted=false, phone_verified=false, payment_method_status=pending_bin_check, signup_region=europe-west, created_at=1778355800
Priya (billing): Pending_bin_check is weird — usually BIN checks are instant. Did customer use 3DS or a redirect payment flow?
Vero (customer): Yes, got 3DS popup during card add, then returned and it showed success.
Sam (support): That lines up. There's a known gating rule: if payment_method_status != verified AND phone_verified=false then free_trial is withheld. But we don't usually block EU cards like this. @Eli can you look at provisioning logs?
Eli (engineer): Looking. Reproduced for acct_01Gxyz — during payment webhook processing our BIN service returned 429 for a short window and we mark payment_method_status=pending_bin_check which blocks the trial grant job. Logs:```
[1778355852] POST /payments/webhook 200
[1778355853] bin-service lookup -> 429
[1778355854] payments: set status=pending_bin_check
[1778355900] trial-grant-job ran -> skipped (payment not verified)```
Eli (engineer): It looks like transient 429 cascaded into skipping the trial grant. Shouldn't be a permanent block.
Nora (oncall): Is there a retry for trial-grant-job? I thought it re-runs on a schedule.
Eli (engineer): It does run, but the retry window is short (5m × 2). If a card remains in pending status after that, we never re-evaluate until a payment method update or manual intervention. That's the bug.
Priya (billing): For immediate relief we can manually set payment_method_status=verified and trigger trial grant for this acct. Customer-facing fix first, infra fix later.
Sam (support): Vero — we can do a manual grant now. Do you want us to go ahead? You'll see ~$200 credits if granted.
Vero (customer): Please do, thanks. I need them to test an integration today.
Sam (support): Ok doing manual steps: 1) mark payment_method_status=verified 2) enqueue trial-grant-job 3) confirmation DM. Executing now.
Eli (engineer): For audit, running admin command: ```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/admin/accounts/acct_01Gxyz/actions/force_verify_payment
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/admin/accounts/acct_01Gxyz/actions/trigger_trial_grant
```
Billing Bot: Action results: payment_method_status=verified -> success, trial_grant job enqueued -> success, credits_granted=200
Sam (support): Vero — I see the credits applied. Account balance now shows 200 credits. Can you confirm in your console?
Vero (customer): Yep I see them now, thank you!! :tada:
Sam (support): Great. We'll keep this ticket open until the infra change is deployed. @Eli can you create a PR to ensure the trial-grant job picks up pending cards that clear within 24h or to add a background re-eval?
Eli (engineer): On it. I created GH-issue #INF-472 and a draft PR to: - add exponential retry for bin-service calls - ensure trial-grant-job re-evaluates pending payment methods up to 24h - emit a metric for skipped_grant_due_to_payment_pending
Nora (oncall): I'll watch the metric in staging and add an alert if skipped_grant_due_to_payment_pending > 5 in 5m after deploy.
Priya (billing): Also adding a runbook note to manually grant credits when BIN service transiently fails for EU issuers.
Sam (support): Thanks all — Vero, closing here if no further issues. If it happens again ping me and I'll escalate to SRE.
Vero (customer): All good, appreciate the quick help!
Sam (support): :thumbsup:
